evidence.summary: Content home renders a vertical feed of article cards, each leading with a headline then a thumbnail.
Each article card carries a byline and publish date in a smaller meta face beneath the headline; preserved on mobile.
Published article anchors byline, publish date, and a named source directly beneath the headline in a meta face.
Article uses a single h1 headline followed by h2 section breaks with consistent reading rhythm.
Related-content region at the article foot links to inspected same-origin article routes.
At the mobile breakpoint the article layout collapses and byline/date/source remain anchored beneath the headline.
The paywalled premium route was blocked and NOT inspected. It must not be presented as a live published article.
The draft route was blocked and NOT inspected. It must not be presented as a live published article.

limitations: The crawl was unauthenticated; the paywalled premium route at https://example.com/c2-content-pilot/premium/deep-analysis was blocked and was NOT inspected.
The draft route at https://example.com/c2-content-pilot/drafts/upcoming-feature was blocked and was NOT inspected.
Only the content home and one published article route were inspected; paywalled and draft routes must never be presented as live published content.
Provenance (byline, publish date, source) is required on every adapted article; stripped or fabricated provenance is forbidden.
The snapshot is non-mutating; no article was edited and no paywall was bypassed during capture.
